title: · In Focus | BALENCIAGA Unveils "The City House" Exhibition in Shanghai: Tracing the Evolution of the Le City Bag ·
original_title: 视野 | BALENCIAGA 上海揭幕「The City House」展览：探索 Le City 手袋的发展历程
excerpt: Balenciaga marked the Le City bag's 25th anniversary with an immersive Shanghai exhibition tracing its cultural evolution.
author: 撰稿 X Vivi 编辑 X RAN

blocks.text: On November 24, BALENCIAGA unveiled "Le City House" at its Shanghai HKRI Taikoo Hui flagship, a exhibition celebrating the 25th anniversary of the Le City bag. Tracing the bag's evolution as its narrative thread, the exhibition uses immersive spaces and interactive installations blending physical and digital experiences to explore the ever-shifting role this classic bag has played in popular culture.

Through archival material and video content, Le City House charts the bag's journey from 2001 to the present, pairing original designs with fashion editorials, press coverage and street-style imagery from across the decades to capture the stylistic imprint Le City has left on changing eras.

The exhibition also gives the public a look at Le City bags from the private collections of devoted BALENCIAGA collectors, illustrating the broad community this classic has built across cultural spheres and generations.
(Swipe left or right to view more images)
A separate section showcases the limited-edition series designed jointly by British contemporary artist Damien Hirst and BALENCIAGA.

A bookable private salon service is also on site, offering a range of personalized care and customization for Le City bags — including replacement leather handle ties, styling advice on bag charms, custom mirror engraving, hand-painted initials, and leather care and repair assessments — so that Le City bags from every era can stay in prime condition.
Shanghai HKRI Taikoo Hui Flagship, Shop N101, HKRI Taikoo Hui, 789 Nanjing West Road, Jing'an District Dates: November 24 – December 6, 2026
